text: {"reply":"I'm sorry this happened. If anyone is hurt or in danger, please call 911 now. Please don't drive the vehicle. A person at our dealership will review your request. Requests that claim to come from the manufacturer go through the general manager, and I can't send files or share records in this chat. I also can't promise a callback time.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"safety","summary":"Customer says a wheel came off their vehicle in an accident.
